notes.title: Cook saga 0.6 Early Access is now available
notes.content:
Hello dear friends,

Cook saga is finally available at mini price on the steam store. I'm really happy to have been able to release it at last. 
The game currently has 10 levels (8 for four players and 2 ‘Elite’ levels for 6 players). 
The first zone, the farm, has been completely reworked to make it more accessible.

Tournament mode still available
During the first few weeks, the game will be updated once a week.

Don't hesitate to review the game. And buy before 3 days, it will never be so cheap again. 

Thank you
Jehal

notes.title: Cook saga will be released in early access on February 21.
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm extremely pleased to announce the early access release (at last) on February 21.
The game will feature two zones, the desert and the farm (which are the first two zones of the game).
Players will be able to choose between 3 professions: Waiter, Chef and Storekeeper.
There will be two game modes at release: Tournament and Campaign.

I look forward to your feedback on the current version of the game.

Jehal

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello dear friends,

I hope you had a wonderful holiday season!
The first round of the tournament went well, so if you still want to take part, you can do so until January 20! Prepare your team and register here.

Most of the discord is in French at the moment, but whatever your nationality or language, you're welcome to join in.

After January 20, we'll organize the second part of the tournament! 

For now, here are the scores:

Les 3P: 2990
Tasty Spatulas: 4070
Sultanian Beta: 5129

Try to beat them, sign up!

I wish you all the best, the game with the campaign will be released at the end of February.
Jehal
